caption:
Comment BLUEPRINT and I'll send it over: the whole faceless model, written out.

If you've started this five times, it wasn't the tool. Five different apps, same result. The gap was never the software.

THE PART NOBODY EXPLAINS

Recurring income isn't a tool. It's a loop. The offer you pick, the post you make, the person who clicks. Miss one part, and the best software in the world does nothing. Get the loop right, and it pays you without you touching it again.

THE FIVE STEPS

1. Pick the offer. Recurring, not one-time.
2. Build one angle. One way in, not five.
3. Post without your face. Screen recording, text over footage, or a voice reading a script.
4. Let the loop run. Stop refreshing the numbers.
5. Repeat the pattern. One post is a guess, ten posts is a pattern.

WHY THIS ACTUALLY WORKS

Every post is a signal. Enough of the same signal, and the platform stops guessing where to put you. You're not making content anymore. You're training the thing that decides who sees it.

THE LOOP DOESN'T CARE WHICH TOOL YOU USED

Not a hack. Not a new app to learn. The accounts that keep getting paid are the ones that never stopped repeating the same three moves.

THE HONEST PART

I'm not going to tell you what you'll make. I don't know you, and I don't know how hard you'll work.

It could be zero. Post once and stop, and it's zero. This is a loop, not a lottery ticket.

Pick it once. Repeat it on purpose.

Comment BLUEPRINT and I'll send it over.
